name: Sathorn Vista, Bangkok - Marriott Executive Apartments
short_description: A long-stay Marriott Executive Apartments tower in Sathorn offering spacious one- to three-bedroom serviced residences with full kitchens and in-unit laundry, built for extended stays.
ai_summary: Sathorn Vista is a Marriott Executive Apartments property, meaning it is a long-stay serviced residence rather than a standard hotel: guests book fully furnished one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments (roughly 65-165 sqm) with full kitchens, stainless-steel appliances, marble bathrooms and in-unit washer/dryers, supported by residential services and housekeeping. The 32-story tower sits just off South Sathorn Road in Bangkok's central business district, a quiet, residential pocket about a 10-15 minute walk from Sala Daeng BTS and Lumphini/Silom MRT. It carries a 4.0/5 TripAdvisor rating (ranked around #167 of 1,384 Bangkok hotels) and roughly 8.8/10 on booking platforms. Reviewers consistently praise the generous apartment size, the home-away-from-home feel for families and relocating expats, attentive staff, and amenities including an outdoor saltwater pool, 24-hour gym, sauna, kids' club and the MoMo Cafe restaurant; the property is also pet-friendly. Common criticisms note that finishes and furnishings feel dated in places, breakfast is fairly basic, and Wi-Fi and gym-equipment reliability can be inconsistent. It is best suited to multi-week or multi-month stays where space, kitchens and value outweigh boutique polish.

faqs.question: Is Sathorn Vista a hotel or a serviced apartment?
faqs.answer: It is a Marriott Executive Apartments property, a long-stay serviced residence. Units are fully furnished one- to three-bedroom apartments with full kitchens, in-unit laundry and residential services, so it suits extended stays more than one-night hotel visits.

faqs.question: How far is it from Suvarnabhumi Airport and the nearest train stations?
faqs.answer: It is roughly 31 km from Suvarnabhumi Airport (about 30-50 minutes by car depending on traffic). Sala Daeng BTS and Lumphini/Silom MRT stations are a 10-15 minute walk away.

faqs.question: Is it a good choice for families and long stays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests consistently highlight the large apartments, full kitchens, kids' club, pool and gym, and pet-friendly policy, making it popular with families, relocating expats and business travelers on multi-week stays.

reviews.title: Review: Sathorn Vista, Bangkok - Marriott Executive Apartments
reviews.author: Jean-Maximilien Voisine
reviews.summary: Detailed stay review praising spacious apartments with full kitchens, a good gym and kids-friendly pool, but flagging dated decor, unreliable Wi-Fi, a weak breakfast and some maintenance lapses; rated good value for long stays.
